_meta.description: Submit a prompt to ChatGPT and capture the response.

prompt.description: The prompt/question to send to ChatGPT
prompt.hint: Can be any length. For multi-line, use newlines in the string.

base_url.description: URL to navigate to before submitting. Use default for new conversation.
base_url.hint: Can point to an existing conversation URL to continue a thread

_meta.callerContract: Pass tabId = an already-authenticated chatgpt.com tab (resolve it via GET /tabs/list). Do NOT rely on tabId auto-discovery: with no tabId the extension picks the active tab of the last-focused window (chrome.tabs.query {active,lastFocusedWindow}), which is usually NOT the ChatGPT tab, and the recipe would then run against the wrong page. This recipe does NOT open its own tab: a cold-opened chatgpt.com tab intermittently redirects to /login (unauthenticated) so the composer never mounts. A durable class-wide fix (prefer a base_url-host tab during discovery) is proposed for background.ts startRun — see _estate/errors / the repair note doc.
_meta.repairNote: 2026-07-08: ChatGPT composer migrated Lexical -> ProseMirror. Two root causes behind the silent {status:ok,value:''} failure, both fixed here: (1) The old bare div[contenteditable='true'] fallback matched a RENDERED MESSAGE (also a ProseMirror contenteditable div, earlier in DOM order) instead of the composer -> selectors now scope to the #prompt-textarea id + aria-label 'Chat with ChatGPT', so a wrong tab now fails LOUDLY ('Cannot resolve: prompt_input') instead of silently succeeding. (2) A CDP-dispatched Enter no longer submits ChatGPT's ProseMirror composer (verified: text stays in the composer, no send) -> now type with submit:false and click send_button explicitly. data-testid='prompt-textarea' and data-lexical-editor are gone from the composer; #prompt-textarea (id) and [data-testid='send-button'] remain valid.

params.prompt: Say hello in exactly one sentence.

prompt_input.description: ProseMirror contenteditable prompt composer (#prompt-textarea, aria-label 'Chat with ChatGPT')
prompt_input.notes: Do NOT use a bare div[contenteditable='true'] fallback: rendered messages are also ProseMirror contenteditable divs and querySelector returns the message element (first in DOM) instead of the composer. Always scope to the #prompt-textarea id.

send_button.description: Send prompt button (present + enabled once the composer has text)

disable_temp_chat.description: Composer-header toggle to leave Temporary Chat. Exists ONLY while temporary chat is active; clicking it drops the ephemeral chat and returns to a fresh normal chat.

chain.note: MUST stay chain[0]: startRun only skips its pre-chain auth-wait when the first step is assess_state. If a navigate step is placed first, the pre-chain auth check fires and times out with 'user did not complete login'. Checks for the /auth wall; onMismatch:continue.

Navigate the (caller-provided, already-authenticated) tab to base_url. Default base_url=chatgpt.com/ gives a fresh single-turn conversation, which keeps the s10 read reliable: [data-message-author-role='assistant']:last-of-type resolves via querySelector (first match in document order), so on a multi-turn page it would return an EARLIER turn's response, not the latest. NOTE: navigate (existing authenticated tab), NOT open_tab — a cold-opened tab intermittently redirects to /login.
settle (was delay 1500ms); resolves on content root, proceeds on timeout

SELF-HEAL: ChatGPT temporary chat can be a sticky account/session default that a full-page navigate re-enters; a submit into it is discarded (no persisted/readable answer). If temporary chat is ON (the 'Turn off temporary chat' toggle is present), branch to disable_temp to turn it off, dropping the ephemeral chat and returning to a fresh normal chat. When temporary chat is already OFF ('Turn on temporary chat' present), state=='normal' matches expect and no branch runs — safe/no-op on normal accounts.

GUARD (belt-and-suspenders after the s2a self-heal): fail fast if we are STILL in Temporary Chat. Ephemeral temp submits are discarded, so without this the recipe would type+submit then hang 180s on the s8 copy-button wait. Negative-lookahead pattern matches a normal chat instantly (pass) but never '?temporary-chat=true', so a temporary chat times out in 8s with a clear 'wait_for url timeout'.
wait for prompt_input before next step (was delay 1200ms)

submit:true sends Enter after the text. On current ChatGPT ProseMirror a CDP Enter is a harmless no-op (does NOT submit, does NOT insert a newline — verified), so the text stays in the composer intact; the real submit is the explicit send_button click in s6. (submit:false is avoided: it makes trustedType press Tab, which moved focus off the composer and the send button failed to resolve on the next step.)
wait for send_button before next step (was delay 400ms)
Click Send — the reliable submit path on current ChatGPT
settle (was delay 1500ms); resolves on content root, proceeds on timeout

Wait until the assistant message's Copy action button appears — the RELIABLE 'answer fully rendered' signal. Do NOT wait on [data-testid='stop-button'] going invisible: for thinking models (e.g. gpt-5-*-thinking) the stop button toggles off during the think→answer transition, so that wait completes while the answer is still empty (assistant container class 'result-thinking', empty

), and the read captures ''. The copy button only appears once generation is truly complete. RELIES on s2's fresh single-turn chat: on a multi-turn page prior turns already have copy buttons, so this would pass immediately. 180s timeout accommodates deep thinking-model latency.
settle (was delay 600ms); resolves on content root, proceeds on timeout
Capture last assistant message. Reliable because s2 navigated to a fresh single-turn chat (only one assistant message present).

steps.note: Turn OFF temporary chat — drops the ephemeral chat, returns to a fresh normal chat
settle (was delay 1000ms); resolves on content root, proceeds on timeout
